operations.source_name: HM Land Registry Title Number and UPRN Look Up technical specification
operations.details_summary: HMLR documents title-number to UPRN relationships and states that links exist only where a relationship can be made between the AddressBase address and title number.

operations.source_name: HM Land Registry Title Number and UPRN Look Up technical specification
operations.details_summary: Title number is treated as an HMLR title-registration identifier; UPRN is a separate spatial-address identifier and the two are not conflated.

operations.source_name: HM Land Registry Title Number and UPRN Look Up technical specification
operations.details_summary: A UPRN association is accepted only when HMLR can make the address-title relationship; a missing UPRN is not converted into an invented parcel identity.

operations.source_name: HM Land Registry Title Number and UPRN Look Up technical specification
operations.details_summary: HMLR warns duplicate address records can leave one record with a title number and no UPRN and another with a UPRN and no title number; address matching alone cannot replace polygon/title identity.

operations.source_name: HM Land Registry Title Number and UPRN Look Up technical specification
operations.details_summary: HMLR states a title can affect many properties and all affecting UPRNs may be associated; one title-to-one-address assumptions are rejected.

operations.source_name: HM Land Registry Title Descriptor technical specification
operations.details_summary: HMLR documents estate interest, class of title and registered status keyed by title number; these attributes are identity/registration metadata, not elevation geometry.

operations.source_name: HM Land Registry Title Descriptor technical specification
operations.details_summary: HMLR states an application awaiting registration can have a title number but no estate or class information; missing descriptor fields therefore cannot invalidate a geometry or create a replacement value.

operations.source_name: HM Land Registry Title Descriptor technical specification
operations.details_summary: Estate interest, class of title and registered status remain descriptive registration attributes; they are not used to manufacture polygon coordinates or terrain heights.

operations.source_name: HM Land Registry INSPIRE Index Polygons
operations.details_summary: The existing INSPIRE contract is preserved: each polygon has its own Land Registry-INSPIRE ID and a registered title can contain several polygons; polygon identity is not collapsed to an address or title-only key.
No title/UPRN/descriptor relationship contradicts the three preserved HMLR polygon IDs; no parcel geometry or height-difference bytes are changed.
Row 30762 / INSPIRE 46058185 remains 0.270 m at 96% result confidence; identity QA creates no numeric mutation and the absolute-95 caution remains.
Row 46142 / INSPIRE 39866294 remains 0.831 m at 96% result confidence; identity QA preserves the strongest separated example.
Row 61522 / INSPIRE 62045430 remains 0.490 m at 96% result confidence; the previously disclosed narrow absolute margin remains unchanged.
The four guarded-recovery receipts remain absent from canonical; no second runner is created and business execution remains blocked.
